description: Get the full profile for one of the user's LinkedIn connections: work history, education, skills, and their About summary. Use this after search_connections when you need depth on a specific person. Identify them by name, or by linkedin_url for an exact match. A found:false response carries the user's imported-connection count: if no_imported_data is set, nothing was searched, so report the missing import rather than a missing person.

linkedin_url.description: Exact LinkedIn profile URL, if known.

name: get_connection_details
title: Get connection details
